name: NeuralClear Seller Agent
description: Seller-side demo agent for NeuralClear for Trusted Agents (Concordium Trusted Agents Hackathon, testnet demo — not a production payment product). Sells a metered CCD/EUR market-data micro-service to badge-verified buyer agents. Every delivery is appended to a hash-chained audit log; payment is accepted only as a single net x402 settlement for accumulated micro-obligations, closed by an Ed25519-signed receipt. Refuses orders from agents whose Verified by Concordium badge does not verify.

skills.name: Fetch CCD/EUR price
skills.description: Returns the current CCD/EUR mid-market price as a metered micro-delivery; each call is one micro-obligation recorded in the hash-chained audit log.

skills.name: Summarise CCD day
skills.description: Returns a one-paragraph summary of today's CCD price action as a metered micro-delivery.

skills.name: Accept net settlement
skills.description: Accepts one net x402 payment covering all confirmed micro-obligations from a badge-verified buyer and co-closes the batch with an Ed25519-signed receipt.

extensions.description: Verified by Concordium badge — on-chain agent identity in a CIS-8004 registry

params.verify: Resolve tokenAddress via CIS-8004 agent_of; confirm owner + status=Active + card SHA-256 == metadata_hash.
